info.title: Cyient DLM Customer Complaint API
info.description:
Backend of the Cyient DLM workflow applications. Every endpoint needs sign-in unless it says otherwise.

**Sign-in (Development):** put a login in the `X-Dev-User` header, for example `CYIENTDLM\ims`, using the authentication box on this page. With no header the default user is used. `X-Dev-Groups` adds AD groups.

**Responses** use one envelope: `success`, `data`, `message`, `errors` (each with `code`, `message` and,
for a field, `field`), `meta` (paging: `page`, `pageSize`, `totalCount`, `totalPages`), `traceId` (quote it
when reporting a problem), `timestamp` and `durationMs`. Files (downloads, Excel, PDF) are sent as they are.

**Errors:** 400/422 validation (`errors[].field` names the field), 401 not signed in, 403 not allowed or not
set up (`AUTH_NOT_REGISTERED`), 404 not found, 409 conflict, such as `PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT` when someone
else saved first, 429 too many calls.

**Changes:** send back the `version` from the last read; a stale one gets 409. New drafts take an
`Idempotency-Key` header, so a repeated click returns the same draft. Dates are `yyyy-MM-dd` in India
time; times are UTC. Enums travel as names, such as `ImsReview`.

remarks.description: What was done. Optional, at most 4000 characters.

version.description: The action's `version` from the last read.

customerId.description: The `id` of a Customer item (`GET /api/v1/masters/Customer`). Required.

complaintDate.description: Defaults to today (India time) when not sent; can't be in the future.

reportedDate.description: The day the customer reported it, when different (picked from a calendar). Can't be in the future.

customerReference.description: The customer's reference number. At most 100 characters.

complaintDescription.description: What the complaint is about. At most 4000 characters.

isRepeat.description: Yes when the complaint repeats an earlier one of the same customer; then pick it in `repeatOfPublicId`.

repeatOfPublicId.description: The earlier complaint (`GET /api/v1/complaints/earlier?customerId=`): a published complaint of the same customer. Needed to publish a repeat complaint; ignored when `isRepeat` is false.

customerContact.description: The customer's contact person. At most 200 characters.

locationId.description: The Cyient DLM facility: the `id` of a Location item.

required.description: The Yes/No question on the first page (to be confirmed by Cyient DLM); when No, a justification is required.

requiredJustification.description: Required when `required` is false. At most 4000 characters.

teamMemberUserIds.description: The team members (CFT): `id`s from the people picker (`GET /api/v1/directory/users`). Replaces the team; their email addresses come from the directory. At least one is needed to publish.

version.description: Required when changing: the version returned by the last read.

ComplaintInput.description: The first page of a complaint (D1 to D3), as sent when creating or changing it (BRD-04 section 5). Only the customer is mandatory (BR-07); the other fields are optional until Cyient DLM confirms them against the 8D form.

ComplaintListItem.description: One row of All external complaints.

description.description: The action taken. Required, at most 4000 characters.

responsibleUserId.description: The responsible person: an `id` from the people picker. Required.

version.description: Required when changing: the line's version from the last read.

ContainmentInput.description: One containment action (D3), as sent when adding or changing it.

EmailDetails.description: An email with what caused it: who acted, and the workflow action (design 9.4).

EvidenceFile.description: A document uploaded as evidence for a D5 action (its current version).

HistoryEntry.description: One line of a complaint's history. Workflow lines have Stage, Action and Comment; data lines have Item (Complaint, Team member, Containment action, Action, Evidence or Document), Action (Insert, Update, Delete, Download, Pdf) and, for updates, Field with its old and new value.

userId.description: The user to give the role to: an `id` from the users list or the people picker.

adGroup.description: An Active Directory group as DOMAIN\Group; its members get the role.

HolderInput.description: Either a user or an AD group (DOMAIN\Group), not both.

name.description: For example Diwali. Required, at most 200 characters.

isActive.description: Switched-off days are kept but no longer count as holidays. Defaults to true.

version.description: Required when changing: the version from the list.

HolidayInput.description: A day in the holiday calendar.

ownerUserId.description: An `id` from the people picker. Optional.

version.description: Required when changing: the line's version from the last read.

InternalActionInput.description: One line of the internal action matrix.

canEdit.description: The initiator may change it and its action lines, and close it, while it is open.

customerId.description: The `id` of a Customer item. Required, also for complaints that start in-house (BR-07).

complaintDate.description: Defaults to today (India time) when not sent; can't be in the future.

locationId.description: The Cyient DLM facility: the `id` of a Location item.

problemDescription.description: What was rejected and why. Required, at most 4000 characters.

version.description: Required when changing: the version returned by the last read.

InternalInput.description: An internal complaint, as sent when recording or changing it. The current form is still to be shared (open item O2); these are the first page's fields that apply to an in-house rejection.

timeZone.description: The zone DailyAt is in: the job's own, or the business time zone.

nextRun.description: When the Notification Service runs it next; null when the job is switched off.

LogEntry.description: One Log entry. Stage is the code (Registration, RootCause, Action); StageName is how users know it.

code.description: A short code, for example HYD. Required, at most 50 characters.

name.description: The name shown in drop-downs. Required, at most 200 characters.

isActive.description: False stops the item being offered; items are never deleted.

version.description: Needed when changing an item; ignored when creating one.

type.description: The list's key, used in the URLs: Location, Department or ReasonCategory.

name.description: The list's display name, for screens only.

pendingCount.description: Tasks waiting for the user in this application (the Pending Actions badge); null where the application has none.

NumberingCheckResult.description:
One counter compared with the numbers its application has actually given out. Numbers are gap-free by design
(design 5.7), so any missing or repeated number, or a counter below a used number, needs looking at.

stage.description: RootCause..., InitiatorReview, or Action for a D5 action (then ActionId says which).

PersonResult.description: One result of the people picker.

RoleHolder.description: One holder of a role: a user, or an AD group whose members hold it.

isActive.description: False switches the role off: its holders lose its permissions.

permissions.description: The full list of permission codes (`GET /api/v1/admin/permissions`); it replaces the current list.

version.description: Needed when changing a role; ignored when creating one.

RoleInput.description: A role's name, description, state and the full list of its permission codes.

version.description: The complaint's `version` from the last read.

RootCauseInput.description: D4: the why-why analysis in three segments. At least one is required; each at most 4000 characters.

version.description: The complaint's `version` from the last read.

StepInput.description: The text of one of the steps D6, D7 and D8. Required, at most 4000 characters.

StoredFile.description: One version of an uploaded document. Versions of the same document share a Guid StoredFile.FileKey.

TeamMemberDetails.description: A team member, with the email address from the directory (CC-05).

UserRoleItem.description: A role the user holds directly; int UserRoleItem.HolderId is used to remove it.

isActive.description: False switches the user off, true switches them on again.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

commit.description: The git commit the build came from, so support can tell exactly which build is running.

comment.description: Shown on the Log tab. Optional.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

WorkflowActionInput.description: A workflow action: an optional comment for the Log tab and the version from the last read.

DevUser.description: Development sign-in: the login to act as, for example `CYIENTDLM\ims`. Left empty, calls are made as the default user.
DevUser.name: X-Dev-User

tags.name: Me
tags.description: The signed-in user, with the roles and permission codes the front end uses to show or hide actions.

tags.name: Master lists
tags.description: Master lists. Anyone signed in reads the active items (for drop-downs); administrators with master.manage see inactive ones too, add items and change them.

tags.name: People picker
tags.description: The people picker, for choosing approvers (design 6.7). Any signed-in user; only active people are found.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Which build of the application this server runs. Any signed-in user.

tags.name: Complaints: 8D steps
tags.description: The 8D steps after publishing (BRD-04 CC-09 to CC-14): D4 root cause, the D5 action plan with each owner's evidence and closure, D6 to D8 in turn, and the initiator's closure; Pending Actions and the Log. These need only sign-in here; who may act at each step (initiator, team member, action owner) is checked by the workflow itself.

tags.name: Complaints: documents
tags.description: The complaint's documents (design 6.7): the first page's evidence images, and every document on the complaint including the D5 actions' evidence, to list and download.

tags.name: Complaints: first page
tags.description: New complaint: the first page (D1 to D3) with the team and the containment actions, and publishing it to the team (BRD-04 CC-01 to CC-08).

tags.name: Complaints: lists and reports
tags.description: All external complaints and the generated 8D report (design 6.7). Files are the one response not wrapped in the envelope; an error before the file starts still is.

tags.name: Internal complaints
tags.description: Internal complaints (in-house rejections, BRD-04 CC-19): a separate, simpler record with an action matrix, outside the 8D flow, and the All internal complaints list. No emails are sent.

tags.name: Admin: Customer Complaint
tags.description: Customer Complaint administration (design 6.8): every complaint with cancel (request.admin), its emails, audit and history, and the holiday calendar kept by IT (master.manage). Cancelling needs a reason, shown on the Log tab.

tags.name: Admin: audit, emails and logs
tags.description: The audit trail (audit.view), the email log with retry and resend (email.manage), and the technical log (log.view). Lists are newest first and paged.

tags.name: Admin: jobs
tags.description: The daily jobs (job.run): when each runs next in the Notification Service, and "run now". A job run now runs in this API and the call returns when it has finished.

tags.name: Admin: numbering
tags.description: Request-number counters and the numbering check (sequence.manage). Read-only: counters are never set by hand.

tags.name: Admin: roles
tags.description: Roles and their permissions (role.manage), and who holds them (user.manage). Holders are users or AD groups. A change that would leave nobody able to manage roles and users is refused.

tags.name: Admin: users
tags.description: People synced from Active Directory: search them, see their roles, switch them off or on in this application.
